title: Jeerawan Jampit
text:
I’m a graduate student in economics at Old Dominion University, where I’m pursuing my M.A. I’m drawn to econometrics, economic analytics, health economics, and business analysis — essentially, any place where data can help explain how people and markets behave. Along the way I’ve worked in data analysis, marketing analytics, competitive intelligence, and staffing analytics, using tools like Excel, SQL, R, Tableau, and Avionté.

“Creativity is thinking up new things. Innovation is doing new things.” - Theodore Levitt
